items.q: Raindrop pigmentation, palmoplantar keratosis and Mees lines on nails after well water exposure suggest which poisoning?
items.exp: Chronic arsenic (often groundwater) causes raindrop hypo and hyperpigmentation, keratoses, transverse Mees nail lines and skin, lung and bladder cancers. Acute arsenic causes rice water gastroenteritis.
r: Incorrect. Lead causes stippling, colic and wrist drop.
Correct. Pigment plus Mees lines means arsenic.
Incorrect. Mercury causes tremor and erethism.
Incorrect. Cadmium causes renal tubular and bone disease.
items.kp: Skin pigment plus nail lines equals arsenic exposure.

items.q: Erethism (shyness, irritability) with tremor and gingivitis in a hat factory worker historically indicates what?
items.exp: Mercury vapour neurotoxicity caused mad hatter erethism with tremor, personality change and gum disease. Minamata methylmercury instead causes visual and cerebellar devastation from fish.
r: Incorrect. Lead causes colic and motor neuropathy without erethism.
Correct. Mad hatter syndrome is mercury.
Incorrect. Arsenic marks skin and nails chronically.
Incorrect. Manganese mimics parkinsonism in welders and miners.
items.kp: Mad hatter equals mercury: tremor plus personality change.

items.q: Upper lobe fibrosis with eggshell hilar node calcification and tuberculosis reactivation risk follows which dust?
items.exp: Silicosis fibroses upper lobes with eggshell calcified nodes and impairs macrophage killing, reactivating tuberculosis (silicotuberculosis). Asbestos favours lower lobes and pleura instead.
r: Incorrect. Asbestos scars lower lobes and pleura.
Correct. Eggshell upper lobe disease means silica.
Incorrect. Simple coal causes macules with little fibrosis.
Incorrect. Beryllium causes sarcoid like granulomas.
items.kp: Eggshell nodes plus upper fibrosis equals silicosis. Screen TB.

items.q: Bleeding swollen gums, perifollicular haemorrhages, corkscrew hairs and reopening of old wounds indicate deficiency of what?
items.exp: Vitamin C is cofactor for collagen hydroxylation, so scurvy weakens vessels and wounds: gums bleed (with teeth present), follicles haemorrhage, hairs coil and healed scars break down.
r: Incorrect. D deficiency softens bone (rickets).
Correct. Collagen failure bleeding means scurvy.
Incorrect. A deficiency blinds by xerophthalmia.
Incorrect. Thiamine causes beriberi and Wernicke syndromes.
items.kp: Reopened wounds plus bleeding gums equals scurvy until disproven.

items.q: Bow legs, rachitic rosary and widened wrists in a toddler with low vitamin D represent what?
items.exp: Rickets is defective mineralisation of growing bone and cartilage causing bowed legs, costochondral rosary, craniotabes and delayed dentition. Osteomalacia is the adult closed plate equivalent with Looser zones.
r: Incorrect. Osteomalacia affects adults after plate closure.
Correct. Growing bone failure means rickets.
Incorrect. Scurvy causes subperiosteal haemorrhage pain differently.
Incorrect. Imperfecta fractures with blue sclerae from collagen mutation.
items.kp: Child soft growing bones equal rickets; adult equal osteomalacia.

items.q: Night blindness progressing to Bitot spots and corneal melting (keratomalacia) reflects deficiency of what?
items.exp: Vitamin A maintains retinal photopigments and epithelial differentiation, so deficiency causes night blindness, conjunctival Bitot spots, xerosis and keratomalacia, a leading preventable childhood blindness with measles synergy.
r: Incorrect. C deficiency causes scurvy bleeding instead.
Correct. Vitamin A lack blinds this way.
Incorrect. E deficiency causes spinocerebellar signs rarely.
Incorrect. Folate causes megaloblastic anaemia and tube defects.
items.kp: Night blindness plus Bitot spots equals vitamin A deficiency.

items.q: Wernicke encephalopathy triad of confusion, ataxia and ophthalmoplegia results from deficiency of what?
items.exp: Thiamine deficiency in alcohol misuse or malnutrition injures mammillary bodies and periaqueductal grey causing Wernicke triad, progressing to Korsakoff amnesia if glucose is given before thiamine replacement.
r: Incorrect. Niacin lack causes pellagra (dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia).
Correct. Thiamine lack causes Wernicke syndrome.
Incorrect. Pyridoxine lack causes sideroblastic anaemia and seizures.
Incorrect. B12 causes cord degeneration and macrocytosis.
items.kp: Thiamine before glucose in confused alcohol misuse: prevent Korsakoff.

items.q: Pellagra (dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia) follows deficiency of which vitamin?
items.exp: Niacin (or tryptophan) deficiency causes photosensitive Casal necklace dermatitis, diarrhoea and dementia (three Ds, death fourth), historically in maize dependent diets and alcohol misuse.
r: Incorrect. Thiamine causes beriberi Wernicke instead.
Correct. Three Ds mean niacin pellagra.
Incorrect. Riboflavin causes cheilosis and glossitis milder.
Incorrect. Biotin deficiency is rare with raw egg excess.
items.kp: Dermatitis plus diarrhoea plus dementia equals pellagra.

items.q: Flaky paint skin, oedema, fatty liver and hair depigmentation in a weaned toddler indicate which malnutrition?
items.exp: Kwashiorkor is protein deficiency despite some calories (weaning onto starch) causing oedema masking wasting, fatty liver, flaky paint dermatosis and red depigmented hair. Marasmus wastes without oedema.
r: Incorrect. Marasmus lacks oedema and fatty liver pattern.
Correct. Oedema plus flaky paint means kwashiorkor.
Incorrect. Rickets deforms growing bones specifically.
Incorrect. Scurvy bleeds and reopens wounds.
items.kp: Oedema in malnutrition means protein lack: kwashiorkor.

items.q: Ionising radiation cancer risk is most classically exemplified by which sequence after exposure?
o: Immediate skin burn tumours within weeks
Leukaemia peaking years later, solid tumours over decades, thyroid cancer in children
No cancer risk below lethal doses
items.exp: Radiation causes acute tissue injury at high dose and stochastic cancer later: leukaemia within years, solid tumours over decades, with childhood thyroid especially sensitive after fallout iodine uptake.
r: Incorrect. Burns are deterministic early effects, cancers are late stochastic.
Correct. Leukaemia early, solids late, thyroid in children.
Incorrect. Sarcomas are one late type among many.
Incorrect. No safe threshold is assumed for stochastic risk.
items.kp: Radiation cancers arrive late: leukaemia first, solids decades on.
